title: Amazon Transcribe
description: The Amazon Transcribe options of meetings streamed to the WebSocket transcriber: the Stream Audio page, the browser extension and the desktop app. The defaults are the values the stack was deployed with; a value set here is used instead until it is reset. Amazon Transcribe checks these options when a meeting starts, and a meeting whose options it refuses is not transcribed: a custom vocabulary or language model must already exist in this account and region, and language identification cannot be combined with a custom language model or with redaction.
appliesText: A saved change applies to streaming meetings that start at least 30 seconds after the save; a meeting already running keeps the options it started with.

languageCode.title: Language
languageCode.description: The language meetings are transcribed in, or identify-language / identify-multiple-languages to identify it from the language options. Default: the TranscribeLanguageCode stack parameter.

languageOptions.title: Language options
languageOptions.description: With language identification, the comma-separated languages a meeting may use, for example "en-US, es-US"; more than five is not recommended. Default: the TranscribeLanguageOptions stack parameter.

preferredLanguage.title: Preferred language
preferredLanguage.description: With language identification, the language to prefer; must be one of the language options. None for no preference. Default: the TranscribePreferredLanguage stack parameter.

contentRedactionEnabled.title: Redact personal information
contentRedactionEnabled.description: Redact the entity types below from transcripts. Applied only when the language is en-US, en-AU, en-GB or es-US, the languages Amazon Transcribe redacts while streaming. Default: the IsContentRedactionEnabled stack parameter.

piiEntityTypes.title: Entity types to redact
piiEntityTypes.description: Comma-separated Amazon Transcribe PII entity types, such as NAME,EMAIL,PHONE. Default: the TranscribePiiEntityTypes stack parameter.

customVocabularyName.title: Custom vocabulary
customVocabularyName.description: The name of an Amazon Transcribe custom vocabulary in this account and region, or empty for none. Default: the CustomVocabularyName stack parameter.

customLanguageModelName.title: Custom language model
customLanguageModelName.description: The name of an Amazon Transcribe custom language model in this account and region, matching the language, or empty for none. Default: the CustomLanguageModelName stack parameter.

showSpeakerLabel.title: Identify speakers within a channel by default
showSpeakerLabel.description: Label the separate voices within one audio channel "(spk_0)", "(spk_1)" when the client that started the meeting does not choose. The Stream Audio page and the desktop app choose per meeting, which wins. Default: the ShowSpeakerLabel stack parameter.
